overview_description.description: Cloudglue provides AI infrastructure and developer tools that act as a video context layer for applications and AI agents. The company offers APIs that handle multimodal processing tasks such as speech transcription, speaker separation, scene description, sound classification, and on-screen text extraction. These APIs convert large collections of organizational video, including sales calls, demos, recordings, and internal meetings, into structured, reusable context that behaves like text. Developers use this context to power semantic video search, question answering over video, and structured data extraction with timestamped references. Cloudglue also supports consumer and agent-style tools built on its platform, enabling users to query and analyze extensive video libraries. Its products are designed to reduce the engineering work required to build and maintain video-focused AI features in software systems.
